description.value: Lotus Garden Express is a Vietnamese and Chinese cuisine restaurant in Langley, BC, offering a broad menu of pho, noodle soups, stir-fries, chow mein, fried rice, and Vietnamese subs. The 'Express' format and delivery service suggest a quick-service, takeout-oriented operation that could serve cyclists needing a hot meal on the go. The menu spans appetizers through lunch combo specials and includes a solid range of vegetarian choices.
